svg.title: From Jerusalem to the Ends of the Earth | 从耶路撒冷到地极
svg.desc: Acts 1:8 reading overview in two panels. The Samaria marker uses the legacy Sebaste point for the region, not an identification of Philip’s city. Dashed links join selected narrative stages, not one journey or ancient roads. Rome is Acts’ final city, not the literal ends of the earth. / 使徒行传1:8阅读概览。撒玛利亚以塞巴斯特代表点提示区域，不认定腓利传道之城。虚线连接选定叙事阶段，不表示单次旅程或古道；罗马是书中最后一城，不等于地理上的地极。
svg.text: From Jerusalem to the Ends of the Earth | 从耶路撒冷到地极
Draft · Approximate / 草稿 · 示意
耶路撒冷、犹太与撒玛利亚
使徒行传1–8章：耶路撒冷、犹太与撒玛利亚
Acts 11–19: Antioch, Asia Minor and Greek cities
使徒行传11–19章：安提阿、小亚细亚与希腊城市
Acts 28: Rome is the final city, not the literal ‘ends of the earth’.
使徒行传28章：罗马是叙事最后一城，不等于地理上的“地极”。
Dashed links: selected stages, not one journey or reconstructed roads.
虚线连接选定阶段，不表示单次旅程，也不重建古道。
*Samaria: a regional marker at Sebaste, not an identification of Philip’s city.
*撒玛利亚：采用塞巴斯特代表点提示区域，不认定腓利传道之城。
Made with Natural Earth · OpenBible.info legacy points (CC BY 4.0)
Original teaching layout; all locations approximate / 原创教学版面；所有地点均为示意
